description: Task specification for the broken cancel-dispatch workspace. These requirements are handed to both arms verbatim. They are not compiler facts: the harness checks them by matching normalized workspace text, so the control arm learns exactly as much from them as the AIL arm does.

brief.task:
A five-module AIL workspace is broken. Make `ailc publish` succeed on it while
the task specification below still holds. The workspace and its project policy
already exist; you repair AIL source.
rules:
`architecture.json` is project policy and is immutable. The harness rejects
   any write to it. Weakening policy is not a solution.

The capability environment is empty and stays empty. There is no capability
   configuration file to add.
brief.feedback_ail:
FEEDBACK POLICY (arm ail): `check` and `publish` return the AIL compiler's
own output verbatim: diagnostic codes, spans, `expected.*` / `actual.*`
details, and architecture rule findings with the numbers the checker
measured. Treat that output as the only source of truth about what is
wrong. Do not guess at causes the compiler did not report.

required_declarations.requirement: record CancelRequest keeps its Text field named value
variant StoreOutcome keeps its five cases in order
required_declarations.pattern: variant StoreOutcome \{ Queued; Running; Missing; Completed; Cancelled; \}

required_declarations.requirement: variant CancelOutcome keeps its four cases in order
required_declarations.pattern: variant CancelOutcome \{ Malformed; Cancelled; NotFound; NotCancellable; \}
fn dispatch\(request: CancelRequest, stored: StoreOutcome\) -> CancelOutcome

required_declarations.requirement: tests.cancel_case keeps its exact signature and calls transport.dispatch
required_declarations.pattern: fn cancel_case\(value: Text, stored: StoreOutcome\) -> CancelOutcome

required_declarations.requirement: a function named summarize still exists in module domain
an empty request value still decides Malformed
a request value containing control characters still decides Malformed
an already cancelled job decides NotCancellable
